subject_group: 6.1.10 Vertical/short takeoff and landing air vehicles

versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle's semi-jetborne flight path response results in flying qualities no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Assess the MIL-HDBK-516, Fixed-Wing Longitudinal Flying Qualities paragraphs and conduct analysis of semi-jetborne flight path response, to evaluate air vehicle capabilities, for all required semi-jetborne loadings and configurations, to include: a. Semi-jetborne formation, at discrete airspeeds or with inclusion of deceleration to a specific minimum airspeed. b. Semi-jetborne landings, including waveoffs. c. STOs with specific stressing flight path maneuvers such as formation STOs and STOs with aggressive flight path acquisition and altitude corrections. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Assess the MIL-HDBK-516, Fixed-Wing Longitudinal Flying Qualities paragraphs and conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess flying/handling qualities for each combination of air vehicles states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Semi-jetborne formation, at discrete airspeeds or with inclusion of deceleration to a specific minimum airspeed. b. Semi-jetborne landings, including waveoffs. c. STOs with specific stressing flight path control maneuvers such as formation STOs and STOs with aggressive flight path acquisition and altitude corrections. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess flying/handling qualities for selected combinations of air vehicles states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Semi-jetborne formation, at discrete airspeeds or with inclusion of deceleration to a specific minimum airspeed. b. Semi-jetborne landings, including waveoffs. c. STOs with specific stressing flight path maneuvers such as formation STOs and STOs with aggressive flight path acquisition and altitude corrections.
